description: Get one image from a preprod snapshot: the current, previous, or diff screenshot, with its metadata. Returns a preview image unless full resolution is requested. Get image file names from get_snapshot or get_latest_base_snapshot.

imageIdentifier.description: Image file name exactly as get_snapshot lists it, including any slashes.

imageResolution.description: `full` returns the original bytes, which can make the response much larger.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: get_snapshot_image
title: Get Snapshot Image
